Dear reader,

Alright, so here's the deal with subscribing; I do not email the list often.
This is certainly not a newsletter; I only send messages when I think you might be interested in something I've posted; right now I'm averaging about one post a year; I do aspire to post more often, but I think we all know how that tends to go around here.
